chunks: Therefore, from now onwards guard yourself and be watchful, because if you recalcitrate till the people of Allāh (are forced to) rush upon you, then matters will be closed for you and whatever can be accepted from you today will not be accepted then; and that is an end to the matter.
ai.seo_question: What is the warning given to Muawiya in Nahj al-Balagha regarding delayed repentance?
ai.summary: In this epistle to Muawiya ibn Abi Sufyan, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) urges him to consolidate his authority and secure his position before the 'people of God' (often interpreted as the general populace or specific tribes) rise in opposition. The warning highlights the fragility of political legitimacy, suggesting that delayed action will lead to a loss of control and the rejection of previously accepted measures, reflecting the Shia emphasis on timely justice and decisive leadership.
